joined.title: The June peak ate the pipeline
joined.subtitle: Bookings (Salesforce) x customer meetings (Google Calendar) x proposals sent (SharePoint) — indexed, Sep = 100

insight.headline: June's 127% bookings peak hid a 51% meeting collapse — today's $1.4M pipe gap began there
insight.detail: Overlaying the three feeds shows the June pull-forward wasn't funded by new selling: customer meetings fell 51% and proposals sent 63% from May to August even as bookings hit $2.91M. Salesforce showed a record month, Calendar just looked like vacation season, and SharePoint's thinning proposal folder had no dashboard — only the join reveals the engine stalled two months before coverage dropped to 3.1x.
insight.action: Approve Kenji's Aug 18 outbound blitz with $250K per-rep pipe targets and a 45-activity weekly floor
